findings.summary: Recovery observation can overwrite a concurrently accepted final result with failed task/attempt state.
findings.trigger: Worker result ingestion or spool replay commits while _inspect_attempt_recovery_with_metadata runs after the new conn.commit; cached received_result remains false.
findings.impact: Supervisor continues recovery/failure logic despite accepted worker_results. Isolated no-progress case leaves worker_results=1 but task and attempt failed; completed-only audit cannot consume it. A progress-bearing case can instead initiate an unnecessary resume.
findings.suggested_action: After every released-writer recovery/process operation, acquire the writer and revalidate latest attempt, owner and worker_results before choosing recovery/failure; route a newly received result through receipt supervision. Add this concurrent receipt regression.

findings.summary: A control process group exiting at the timeout boundary raises ProcessLookupError and terminates the daemon.
findings.trigger: communicate times out, then the whole group exits before either os.killpg call.
findings.impact: Uncaught ProcessLookupError bypasses structured child_timeout and _reconcile_child_result; run_daemon catches it as fatal and stops polling. Managed-run cleanup is postponed until restart/other recovery.
findings.suggested_action: Handle absent groups around TERM/KILL as an exit race, reap and verify group liveness, and preserve executor_id plus structured child_timeout so managed-run cleanup still executes. Add TERM/KILL exit-race coverage.

findings.summary: Remaining control deadline is still ignored on supported remediation worktree and publication command paths.
findings.trigger: CI/merge-conflict remediation selects prepare_existing_pr_worktree, or local publication starts near the control deadline.
findings.impact: Raw Git calls have no timeout, and publication calls retain a fixed 60-second cap; remaining-budget exhaustion still causes the daemon outer timeout to kill execution during Git/GitHub I/O instead of completing the intended cooperative deadline path. Executor cleanup reduces lease residue but does not complete this R06 subclaim.
findings.suggested_action: Apply common.run_command with runner injection to remaining supported long Git/gh paths, including prepare_existing_pr_worktree and publish bounded_command, and test that an expired deadline prevents invocation. Preserve publication intent/reconciliation handling.
